llmnav-catalog/1 repository=zdp-design-system catalog=repository
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@zdp.design.package.build
role Assemble and validate a complete package staging tree before publishing it locally.
owns package assembly, runtime and type entry generation
excludes npm publication, token value design
invariant The staging tree must contain all required public files before replacing the package output.

@zdp.design.package.recovery
role Recover interrupted package replacement and restore the previous directory when promotion fails.
owns directory replacement, failed promotion recovery
excludes package assembly, npm publication
invariant A failed promotion restores the previous target when its backup exists.

@zdp.design.styles.parity
role Check that component base layout, interaction states and conditional CSS remain represented in shared styles.
owns base layout parity, interaction style parity, conditional declaration parity
excludes token generation, component business decisions
invariant Shared styles must retain component state declarations under their original conditional context.

@zdp.design.tokens.generate
role Derive the public token name list from the design token tree.
owns token name generation, token leaf flattening
excludes token value design, CSS rendering
invariant Generated token names mirror the source token tree without manual edits.
